title: Lunch rush at Foundry Hall
question: Where do we lose diners at noon: the hyped ramen counter, the coffee kiosk or the tables, and what is the cheapest fix?
context: Weekday lunch at Foundry Hall, a downtown food hall with six stalls, one coffee kiosk and shared tables. Most people are office workers on a short break, and tables are first come, first served.
leaveLabel: Give up and eat somewhere else

nodes.name: Kumo Ramen
nodes.about: Hand-pulled ramen that went viral online; by noon the line snakes past the entrance

nodes.name: Lupe's Tacos
nodes.about: Fast, cheap street tacos; the line looks long but moves quickly

nodes.name: Greenline Salads
nodes.about: Build-your-own salads and grain bowls; regulars order ahead in the app

nodes.name: Forno Slice
nodes.about: Pizza by the slice, ready in a minute; the cheapest lunch in the hall

nodes.name: Saffron Grill
nodes.about: Halal chicken and rice plates with big portions; regulars swear by it

nodes.name: Lotus Dumplings
nodes.about: Small family stall; dumplings are steamed to order, so the wait is longer than the line looks

nodes.name: Ember Coffee kiosk
nodes.about: The only espresso in the building; two baristas; an after-lunch coffee line builds around 12:30

nodes.name: Shared tables
nodes.about: 70 shared seats in the middle of the hall; no reservations; hard to find a seat around 12:15

archetypes.name: Office workers on a lunch break
archetypes.description: Short break; order, sit for twenty minutes, maybe grab a coffee on the way out.

archetypes.name: Takeout grabbers
archetypes.description: Order and walk straight back to their desks; never sit down.

archetypes.name: Students and visitors
archetypes.description: No rush; came for the famous ramen and a table to hang out at.

minds.name: Priya Nair
minds.bio: Product manager with a 12:30 standup; eats at her desk if the lines are long.
minds.goal: A salad and back upstairs by 12:25
minds.social: uses the Greenline order-ahead app and the team's lunch Slack channel

minds.name: Marcus Bell
minds.bio: Construction project manager visiting the site next door; very hungry.
minds.goal: A big plate he can eat sitting down
minds.social: goes wherever his two-person crew wants; they love Saffron Grill

minds.name: Hana Sato
minds.bio: Lawyer who has tried and failed to get Kumo Ramen three times this month.
minds.social: a coworker texts her the ramen line length from the skybridge

minds.name: Devon Carter
minds.bio: Junior analyst on a tight budget, paying off student loans.
minds.goal: The cheapest filling lunch and a seat with coworkers
minds.social: eats with two coworkers who always pick tacos

minds.name: Linda Park
minds.bio: Office manager who has eaten at Lotus Dumplings every Thursday for years.
minds.goal: Dumplings and a table with her lunch group
minds.social: her lunch group of four saves seats for each other

minds.name: Omar Haddad
minds.bio: Engineer who keeps halal; Saffron Grill is his only hot option in the hall.
minds.goal: Saffron Grill or a slice of cheese pizza, nothing else
minds.social: reads the building Slack where people post line lengths

minds.name: Emma Roth
minds.bio: Comes into the office on Tuesdays and likes to work from a table over lunch.
minds.goal: Coffee and a table to work at for a while
minds.social: checks the hall's seat display before coming down

minds.name: Kevin Liu
minds.bio: Trader who eats at his desk; the afternoon session starts soon.
minds.goal: Anything in under five minutes, then a coffee
minds.social: trusts the app's wait times over anything he hears

minds.name: Rosa Delgado
minds.bio: Nurse from the clinic upstairs on a 30-minute break.
minds.goal: Food she can eat on the walk back
minds.social: the clinic group chat says which lines are short

minds.name: Tom Becker
minds.bio: Sales director who buys coffee for his whole team before the 1 pm call.

minds.name: Aisha Mensah
minds.bio: Bike courier grabbing lunch between deliveries; her bike is locked outside.
minds.goal: A slice and back on the road in five minutes
minds.social: other couriers in a group chat

minds.name: Jun Park
minds.bio: Design student who saw Kumo Ramen on social media and took the train in.
minds.goal: A ramen video for his followers, then hang out at a table
minds.social: follows food influencers and their comment threads

minds.name: Margaret O'Neill
minds.bio: Retired teacher meeting an old friend; a table matters more than the food.
minds.goal: A quiet table and something light

minds.name: Lucas Ferreira
minds.bio: Tourist on a walking tour of downtown with an hour to spare.
minds.social: the tour guide recommended Lupe's Tacos
